name: Inraku no Kusari ~Chat Lady Kanraku~
original_name: 淫落の鎖～チャットレディ姦落～
source:
Main character is a temporary teacher at a private school. He infiltrates "Strawberry Girls" live chat and gets acquainted with Nanami. She does not know identity of her new friend and exposes herself to blackmail.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一所私立学校的临时老师。他潜入“草莓女孩”实时聊天并结识了七海。她不知道新朋友的身份，因此遭受勒索。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
